svg.title: The Libero top-level canvas of fabric design 102, zoomed in. aegis_pqc2_0 has a clock, a reset, an APB target and an AXI4 initiator. Its APB target goes to FIC_3_PERIPHERALS_0, slot 14; its AXI4 initiator goes to the new AEGIS_DMA port of FIC_0_PERIPHERALS_0, a second master port of the FIC0 interconnect, whose slave port reaches the MSS FIC_0_AXI4_TARGET and from there DDR.
svg.desc: The Libero top-level canvas of fabric design 102, zoomed in. aegis_pqc2_0 has a clock, a reset, an APB target and an AXI4 initiator. Its APB target goes to FIC_3_PERIPHERALS_0, slot 14; its AXI4 initiator goes to the new AEGIS_DMA port of FIC_0_PERIPHERALS_0, a second master port of the FIC0 interconnect, whose slave port reaches the MSS FIC_0_AXI4_TARGET and from there DDR.

g.text: The new core: APB target in, AXI4 initiator out, on the 50 MHz clock.
APB address decoding: the core is in slot 14 at 0x40000E00, as before.
New ports AEGIS_DMA and AEGIS_DMA_CLK: a second master on the FIC0 interconnect, with clock crossing.
Into the MSS and DDR: where the squeezed blocks land.
